correctness.rationale: The rank-five cd-index of a four-polytope has coefficients c^4+(s-2)c^2d+(r-s)cdc+(v-2)dc^2+(m-e-r-v-s+4)d^2. The cited universal right-augmented-Chow cd-to-gamma map then gives gamma1=3s+2e-9 and gamma2=7m-7e-5r-6v-8s+23. Euler v-e+r-s=0 rewrites these as gamma1=26+4(v-5)+2(e-2v)+3(s-5) and 3(gamma2-43)=12(s-5)+27(e-2v)+4(m-3e)+17(m-3r). All five defects are nonnegative because every vertex degree >=4, edge link has >=3 polygonal faces, each two-face >=3 edges, and v,s>=5. Equality in gamma1 forces v=5, while equality in gamma2 forces s=5; either forces a 4-simplex.
